name: CSV ↔ JSON converter
description: Convert CSV spreadsheets into structured JSON arrays, or convert JSON arrays back into CSV rows.

seo.metaTitle: CSV ↔ JSON converter — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Convert CSV spreadsheets into structured JSON arrays, or convert JSON arrays back into CSV rows. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/csv-json-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: CSV ↔ JSON converter processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/csv-json-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does CSV ↔ JSON converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. CSV ↔ JSON converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/csv-json-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate CSV ↔ JSON converter?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/csv_json.json or open /tools/csv-json?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
